title: Spinning Top Candlestick: What It Really Means And How To Trade It | Trading Strategy Guides

claims.claim: For a bearish reversal setup at resistance, enter short the moment price trades 1 to 2 ticks below the spinning top’s lower wick, or wait for the confirmation candle to close below that level for added safety.
A weekly spinning top represents an entire five days of trading where massive institutional volume failed to expand the range past the open and close.
The long upper wick and stalled body matter far more than whether the close finished a fraction of a percent above the open.
Ignoring Wider Market Structure: Attempting to short a spinning top on a 1-hour chart against a roaring daily and weekly macro trend is a low-probability play.
